name: Respiratory Diseases: ICDCODESET 01, diagnosis positions 1, All Admissions
description: Respiratory Diseases MedPAR outcome definition using ICD code set 01, where a qualifying admission must have a respiratory disease diagnosis code in the primary diagnosis position (`dx1`). The `all_admissions` criterion includes all qualifying inpatient admissions, without applying a readmission-specific restriction. Aggregate products summarize qualifying admissions by county/year and ZCTA/year.

content.admission_date: Timestamp[us]: Admission date of the beneficiary
content.discharge_date: Timestamp[us]: Discharge date of the beneficiary
content.outcome: String: Outcome short name. Please look at the corresponding configuration file for the outcome short names at https://github.com/NSAPH-Data-Processing/medpar_outcomes/tree/main/conf/icd_codes.
content.outcome_criteria: String: Defines the rule used to evaluate ICD codes for admissions. `all` considers all available diagnosis codes for the admission and `first_n` considers only a specified number of diagnosis codes when determining whether the admission meets the outcome criteria
content.outcome_index: Int64: Sequential index of the outcome events for the beneficiaries
